description: PITCHWARP: transposes successive runs of wavecycles by random amounts within +/-octvary octaves, re-picking the transposition every (random, at most cyclelen) cycles - drunken pitch wobble at waveset granularity. CLOCK-SEEDED STOCHASTIC with NO seed argv: runs in different seconds differ; two runs launched within the SAME second are byte-identical (verified both ways - the same srand(time(0)) construction as modify radical 2/shred). Duration is nominally static but wanders with the random transpositions: at octvary 0.1 within 0.1% (flat noise 1.9994/1.9982/1.9987 from 2.0), at 0.5 about +/-4%, at octvary 2 observed +30% on a tone - budget tolerance proportional to octvary. Both musical params are breakpoint-capable, proven with seed-matched same-second runs (brk render differs from both scalar endpoints while two identical-argv runs in the same second collide byte-identically). MONO only.
musical_use: Instant pitch-drunkenness: small octvary (0.05-0.2) adds analog-tape warble and chorus-like instability while keeping duration essentially intact; 0.5-1 smears melody into seasick glissandi; toward 8 the source becomes a random-walk register scribble. cyclelen sets how often the pitch lurches - small values (2-8) give fizzy per-grain scatter, large (64-500) slow drunken drift. Breakpoint octvary from 0 upward to make a sound progressively lose its pitch footing. Note every render is unrepeatable (clock-seeded): render once and keep the file, or embrace the variation for texture beds.

octvary.description: Maximum random transposition, up or down, in octaves (CDP-enforced 0.000002-8: 9 refused 'out of range (0.000002 to 8.000000)'; quirk: 0 is ACCEPTED despite the quoted floor and renders near-passthrough). Duration drift grows with it. Breakpoint-capable (banner-confirmed; seed-matched proof: 0.1->2 ramp differs from both endpoints in same-second runs).

cyclelen.description: Maximum wavecycles between new transposition picks; the actual count is random below this (CDP-enforced 2-32767: 1 and 1.5 refused 'out of range (2.000000 to 32767.000000)' - banner's '>1' is exact; default 64). Breakpoint-capable (seed-matched proof: -c 4->100 ramp differs from both -c4 and -c100 in same-second runs).

skipcycles.description: Wavecycles to skip at the start of the file. Scalar only: breakpoint refused 'ERROR: Cannot read parameter 3 [ov.brk]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'

examples.expected_use: Gentle drunken detune; output length within ~0.1% of the input. Unrepeatable run to run (clock seed).
Starts nearly stable, ends leaping wildly; expect duration to drift several percent at the wild end.

known_issues: CLOCK-SEEDED, UNSEEDABLE: no seed parameter exists; initrand48() = srand(time(0)). Two runs in the same second are byte-identical (collision trap for A/B tests and cache keys); runs in different seconds differ in both content and length.

Duration honesty: static within 0.1% at octvary 0.1 (pinned row), ~4% at 0.5, +30% observed at octvary 2 on a periodic tone - the model degrades as octvary grows because transposed cycles change total length stochastically.
octvary 0 is accepted despite the quoted CDP floor of 0.000002 and renders near-passthrough (1.9977 s from 2.0) - undocumented.
Unipolar / zero-crossing-free material refused: 'ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK: / ERROR: Cycle too large for buffer at 1.486077' (whole file reads as one giant cycle).
Stereo refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255) -> mono.
